policy_title: Prioritise Equal Access for Women and Girls in Grassroots Sport
stated: The Conservative Party will prioritise equal access for women and girls in its ongoing program of investment in grassroots sports facilities.

source.quote: We will prioritise equal access for women and girls in our ongoing programme of investment in grassroots sports facilities.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly prioritises equal access for women and girls in publicly-funded grassroots facilities — a direct gender-equality/anti-discrimination measure that bears on equal treatment indicators.

Grassroots sports participation is a well-evidenced driver of civic participation, social trust and community belonging; widening equal access for a structurally underserved group concretely moves these cohesion indicators.

membership_note: Two genuine bearings: O9 for the equal-access mandate and O15 for the grassroots-sport cohesion pathway. Health benefits (O3) are plausible but too indirect (facilities → participation → NHS demand) to clear the non-negligible bar; prosperity (O13) and public-finance (O12) effects depend on scale of investment not specified in the policy text.
